facts.text: The resort faces a sandy beach on Natadola Bay, looking out to the South Pacific.
facts.excerpt: Facing one of the world’s best sandy beaches and looking out over the azure waters of a beautiful bay to the expanses of the South Pacific

facts.text: The resort echoes the layout of a traditional Fijian village, with rooms and suites spread across 35 acres of beachside tropical gardens.
facts.excerpt: the resort echoes the layout of a traditional Fijian village, with rooms and suites spread across 35 acres of beachside tropical gardens

facts.text: Every room has a generous outdoor living space with a daybed and the resort's signature Cleopatra bath.
facts.excerpt: each feature generous outdoor living spaces with daybeds and our signature Cleopatra baths

facts.text: Plunge Club Suites come in one- and two-bedroom versions, and Club suites include lounge access.
facts.excerpt:
One Bedroom King Plunge Club Suite may include:

- Luxury Bath View

- Separate Bath and Walk-in Shower

- Daybed

- Lounge Access

facts.text: Spa InterContinental offers Eastern and Western treatments infused with local herbs and honey.
facts.excerpt: Our Fiji resort offers Eastern and Western treatments, infused with local herbs and honey to restore balance.

facts.text: The spa has hydrotherapy, a sauna and steam bathing.
facts.excerpt:
- Hydro Therapy
  - Masseuse
  - Sauna
  - Steam Bathing

facts.text: The Natadola Bay Championship Golf Course is an 18-hole course on site, with coral reefs and the Pacific Ocean as a backdrop on 15 of the 18 holes.
facts.excerpt: With the sparkling backdrop of coral reefs and the Pacific Ocean on 15 out of the 18 holes, keeping your concentration will certainly be a challenge!

facts.text: Kama Lounge hosts a nightly torch-lighting ceremony at sunset, with Polynesian fire dancing, island dance and traditional meke.
facts.excerpt: Follow the palm-lined path to Kama Lounge for the nightly torch-lighting ceremony and spectacular South Pacific sunset. Join in authentic traditional Polynesian fire dancing, island dance, and traditional meke.

facts.text: Besides the beach, the resort has outdoor pools including a family pool, an adult-only pool and a Club pool.
facts.excerpt: we offer three outdoor pools, including a family pool, an adult-only pool and a Club pool

facts.text: Navo Restaurant overlooks the lagoon and Navo island, serving dishes like Yasawas Island lobster kokoda and Natadola mud crab salad from a glass show kitchen.
facts.excerpt: The chic Navo Restaurant overlooks the lagoon and the unspoiled island of Navo. Fine world wines complement modern specialities like Yasawas Island lobster kokoda and Natadola mud crab salad, all prepared in a glass show kitchen.

facts.text: One beachside cabana is available each evening for a private dinner for two with a personal waiter on the shores of Natadola Bay.
facts.excerpt: One exclusive cabana is available every evening for romantic dining under the stars. Surprise your loved one with an elegant evening for two with a menu and wines served by your own personal waiter on the shores of Natadola Bay.

facts.text: The Bee Happy Experience is a hands-on session with honey bees followed by a honey high tea.
facts.excerpt: Afterward, enjoy a specially curated honey high tea and sample some delicious honey.

facts.text: Snorkeling, scuba diving and shark diving can be done at Natadola Bay.
facts.excerpt: explore the colourful marine life on display here at Natadola Bay with activities ranging from Snorkelling, Scuba Diving to Shark Diving

facts.text: The resort offers children's activities, babysitting and a nanny for hire.
facts.excerpt:
- Babysitting

- Children's activities onsite

- Nanny for hire

facts.text: Breakfast is included with the stay.
facts.excerpt: Breakfast is free with your stay at the InterContinental Fiji Golf Resort & Spa.

facts.text: The resort is about 45 kilometers from Nadi International Airport.
facts.excerpt: approximately 27.96 miles away (45 kilometers) from the hotel

facts.text: Even standard rooms are sizable, and all include an outdoor living area that extends the space while keeping privacy.
facts.excerpt: Even the standard rooms are sizable, and all include an outdoor living area that extends the usable space while still granting privacy.

facts.text: The resort sits on what many consider the finest beach on Viti Levu, Fiji's main island.
facts.excerpt: Sitting on what many consider to be the finest beach on Fiji’s main island of Viti Levu

facts.text: Spa InterContinental was named Fiji's Best Resort Spa by the World Spa Awards in 2022.
facts.excerpt: World Spa Awards - Fiji's Best Resort Spa, 2022
